title: GenSelect: A Generative Approach to Best-of-N
authors_zh: Shubham Toshniwal、Ivan Sorokin、Aleksander Ficek、Ivan Moshkov、Igor Gitman
paper_type_zh: 生成式 Best-of-N 选择与测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 研究 rollout 选择器、生成式 verifier、测试时算力核算与候选轨迹审计的读者
one_line: GenSelect asks a reasoning model to compare indexed solution summaries, emit a chosen candidate index, and scale selection over 64-solution pools through repeated N-ary knockout tournaments; a related official release exposes 565,620 packed selector rows.
GenSelect 让推理模型联合比较带索引的数学解答摘要并生成所选索引，再用 N 叉淘汰赛扩展到 64 个候选；其论文实验轨迹未发布，565,620 条公开记录来自相关但不同的 OpenMathReasoning split。
why: It separates candidate generation, comparative selector reasoning, chosen index, tournament budget, and final correctness, while the difference between the unreleased paper evaluation pools and the packed public training split shows exactly which rejected candidates, labels, and compute records remain auditable.
inclusion_reason: GenSelect exposes a concrete Best-of-N trace object consisting of candidate summaries, generative selector reasoning, a chosen index, tournament structure, repeated-selection budget, and final correctness, while the related public split enables partial audit of full candidate groups and non-selected summaries.

title: Problem
问题
html:
GenSelect addresses a concrete Best-of-N bottleneck: after a model samples many independent mathematical solutions, how should a reasoning model choose one without scoring every candidate in isolation or paying for exhaustive pairwise comparison? The work was presented as a poster at the 2nd AI for Math Workshop at ICML 2025; the arXiv record was submitted on 23 July 2025. It belongs in Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data because the operative object is a pool of sampled attempts plus selector traces, tournament decisions, and a final outcome under a stated inference budget.

For the target experiments, one record starts with a Comp-Math-24-25 problem, 64 solutions sampled by QwQ-32B or DeepSeek-R1-0528, final answers extracted from those solutions, summary representations of their reasoning, one or more GenSelect comparison traces ending in a zero-based candidate index, tournament-round metadata, and answer correctness or an HMMT LLM-judge result. The paper evaluates prompt-only selection; it neither trains a selector nor establishes an RL or SFT recipe. Its evidence supports an L4 Card because the paper, appendix, prompts, models, budgets, and results are documented, but the exact Comp-Math candidate pools, selector generations, chosen-index manifest, judge outputs, permutations, and seeds were not released.

A related official artifact needs a separate boundary. OpenMathReasoning exposes 565,620 genselect rows constructed for training from AoPS-centered problems. Those rows pack indexed candidate summaries into problem and selector reasoning plus Judgment: IDX into generated_solution. They are attributable GenSelect data from the same NVIDIA line, but they are not the target paper's QwQ/DeepSeek Comp-Math-24-25 evaluation traces.

GenSelect 处理一个具体的 Best-of-N 瓶颈：模型独立采样出许多数学解答后，如何让推理模型选出一个答案，同时避免逐个孤立打分或穷举两两比较的开销？该工作以 poster 形式发表于 ICML 2025 的 2nd AI for Math Workshop，arXiv 记录提交于 2025 年 7 月 23 日。它属于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，因为核心对象是带有明确推理预算的一组采样尝试，以及 selector trace、淘汰赛决策与最终结果，而不是单个答案。

目标实验中的一条记录从 Comp-Math-24-25 题目开始，包含 QwQ-32B 或 DeepSeek-R1-0528 采样的 64 个解答、从解答中抽取的最终答案、推理过程的摘要表示、一个或多个以零基候选索引结尾的 GenSelect 比较轨迹、淘汰赛轮次元数据，以及答案正确性或 HMMT LLM-judge 结果。论文评估的是 prompt-only 选择；它没有训练 selector，也没有建立 RL 或 SFT recipe。论文、附录、prompt、模型、预算和实验结果足以支持 L4 Card，但精确的 Comp-Math 候选池、selector generation、chosen-index manifest、judge output、候选排列与 seed 均未发布。

另一个官方相关 artifact 必须单独界定。OpenMathReasoning 发布了 565,620 条为训练构建的 genselect 记录，题目主要来自 AoPS。公开行把带索引的候选摘要打包在 problem 中，把 selector reasoning 与 Judgment: IDX 打包在 generated_solution 中。这些是同一 NVIDIA 研究脉络中可归因于 GenSelect 的数据，但不是目标论文中 QwQ/DeepSeek 在 Comp-Math-24-25 上的评测轨迹。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is to turn comparative verification into text generation over an entire candidate set. Given a problem and indexed solution summaries, GenSelect asks a reasoning model to screen contradictory answers, analyze the surviving methods, compare mathematical precision, completeness, clarity, efficiency, and robustness, and finish with Judgment: [IDX]. The native selector signal is therefore a generated rationale plus a discrete index, not a calibrated scalar reward. It can observe the problem, the supplied summaries, candidate order, and final answers; it cannot inspect reasoning details lost during summarization, ground-truth correctness during selection, hidden model state, or whether the candidate pool covers a correct approach.

When all candidates do not fit in context, the method organizes the same comparison into an N-ary knockout tournament. For 64 candidates, the paper contrasts a binary bracket requiring 63 comparisons over six sequential rounds with a 16-way bracket requiring four first-round calls and one four-way final over two rounds. The final reported setup uses branching factor \(N=8\), two rounds, 32 repetitions under random candidate permutations, and majority voting over the selected answers. Pool size, branching factor, and selector repetitions are separate fields and should not be collapsed into a single "N".

The nearest baselines are majority voting, Qwen2.5-Math-RM-72B as a discriminative outcome reward model, a pointwise QwQ GenRM, and pairwise tournament schemes such as PairJudge-RM. GenSelect changes the comparison interface from one-candidate or two-candidate scoring to joint N-way generated reasoning; it reuses prompting, solution summaries, knockout tournaments, and majority aggregation rather than introducing a new base model or verifier-training objective. The related OpenMathReasoning split demonstrates a training-data serialization of this interface, but its construction predates and differs from the paper's unreleased evaluation pool.

本文的贡献是把比较式 verification 改写为面向整个候选集合的文本生成。给定题目和带索引的解答摘要，GenSelect 要求推理模型筛查相互矛盾的答案，分析剩余方法，比较数学精确性、完整性、清晰度、效率与稳健性，最后输出 Judgment: [IDX]。因此，selector 的原生信号是生成式 rationale 加一个离散索引，而不是经过校准的标量 reward。它能观察题目、提供给它的摘要、候选顺序和最终答案；它无法看到摘要过程中丢失的推理细节、选择时的 ground-truth correctness、隐藏模型状态，也无法判断候选池是否覆盖了正确方法。

当全部候选无法同时放入 context 时，方法把同一比较组织成 N 叉淘汰赛。对 64 个候选，论文比较了需要六个串行轮次、总计 63 次比较的二叉赛制，与需要四次首轮调用和一次四路决赛、共两轮的 16 路赛制。最终报告的设置采用分支数 \(N=8\)、两轮淘汰赛、在随机候选排列下重复 32 次，再对所选答案做 majority voting。候选池大小、分支数与 selector 重复次数是三个不同字段，不应合并成一个含糊的“N”。

最接近的 baseline 包括 majority voting、作为 discriminative outcome reward model 的 Qwen2.5-Math-RM-72B、逐点 QwQ GenRM，以及 PairJudge-RM 一类两两淘汰赛方法。GenSelect 把比较接口从单候选或双候选打分改成联合 N 路生成式推理；它复用了 prompting、解答摘要、淘汰赛与多数聚合，并未引入新的 base model 或 verifier training objective。相关的 OpenMathReasoning split 展示了这种接口的训练数据序列化，但其构建早于且不同于论文中未发布的评测候选池。

title: Method
方法
html:
The target-paper pipeline is:

  1. Inputs. Build Comp-Math-24-25 from 30 AIME 2024, 30 AIME 2025, 62 HMMT November 2024, 68 HMMT February 2024, and 66 HMMT February 2025 problems. Proof questions and questions with estimated partial credit are excluded, leaving 256 evaluation problems.
  2. Candidate generation and representation. QwQ-32B or DeepSeek-R1-0528 samples independent solutions at temperature 0.6. The main comparisons use 64 candidates per problem. Ans(Y) extracts each final answer; Summary(Y) represents the long solution. Reasoning-model solutions naturally expose a post-thinking solution, while QwQ summaries are regenerated with Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using the Appendix A.1 prompt. The paper says preliminary experiments found no significant benefit from full traces over summaries.
  3. Selection. QwQ-32B or DeepSeek-R1-0528 acts as its own prompt-only GenSelect verifier. A direct call jointly compares up to the context-limited group size and emits comparative reasoning ending in Judgment: [IDX]. Larger pools enter an N-ary knockout tournament; each winner becomes a candidate in the next round.
  4. Aggregation and outcome. Table 3 evaluates one or eight QwQ selections, with majority voting when repeated. The final setup partitions 64 candidates into \(N=8\) groups, runs two tournament rounds, repeats the tournament 32 times under random permutations, and majority-votes the answers selected by those runs.
  5. Evaluation. AIME-style questions use extracted-answer correctness. HMMT uses the LLM-judge setup cited by the paper, so the overall verification contract is mixed. Pass@64 is an oracle upper bound, not a deployable selector.

Final reported decoding uses a 32K maximum output length, temperature 0.6, and top-p 0.95. The budget ablation compares \(2N\) solution generations plus majority voting with \(N\) solution generations plus \(N\) GenSelect generations; this matches generation-call counts approximately, not tokens or latency, and selection cannot begin until candidate generation finishes. The paper does not report target-pool decontamination, exact prompt-version hashes, random seeds, judge outputs, or a released execution manifest.

The related OpenMathReasoning construction is a different pipeline: answer-labeled solution pools are summarized; each problem yields eight distinct groups of 2–16 summaries containing at least one correct and one incorrect candidate; QwQ-32B selects among them; selections choosing an incorrect candidate are removed; and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct cleans the accepted comparison trace. Roughly one million generations were filtered to 565,620 public rows. The public nine-field schema retains the complete candidate-summary group and non-selected summaries inside problem, and retains the rationale plus parseable index inside generated_solution; it does not expose a standalone chosen-index column or a per-candidate correctness-label vector.

目标论文的 pipeline 如下：

  1. 输入。 Comp-Math-24-25 由 30 道 AIME 2024、30 道 AIME 2025、62 道 HMMT 2024 年 11 月、68 道 HMMT 2024 年 2 月和 66 道 HMMT 2025 年 2 月题目组成。排除证明题和按估计准确率给予部分分数的题目后，共有 256 道评测题。
  2. 候选生成与表示。 QwQ-32B 或 DeepSeek-R1-0528 以 temperature 0.6 独立采样解答，主要比较为每题 64 个候选。Ans(Y) 抽取最终答案，Summary(Y) 表示长解答。推理模型的输出天然包含 thinking 之后的 solution；QwQ 的摘要则依据 Appendix A.1 prompt 由 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 重新生成。论文称预实验未发现完整轨迹相对摘要具有显著收益。
  3. 选择。 QwQ-32B 或 DeepSeek-R1-0528 通过 prompt-only 方式充当自身的 GenSelect verifier。单次调用在 context 限制允许的组大小内联合比较候选，生成比较推理，并以 Judgment: [IDX] 结尾。更大的候选池进入 N 叉淘汰赛，每一轮胜者成为下一轮候选。
  4. 聚合与结果。 Table 3 评估一次或八次 QwQ 选择，重复时使用 majority voting。最终设置把 64 个候选按 \(N=8\) 分组，运行两轮淘汰赛，在随机排列下重复 32 次，再对这些运行所选出的答案做多数投票。
  5. 评测。 AIME 类题目使用抽取答案的正确性；HMMT 使用论文引用的 LLM-judge 设置，因此整体 verification contract 是 mixed。Pass@64 是 oracle 上界，不是可部署的 selector。

最终报告的 decoding 设置为最大 32K 输出 token、temperature 0.6、top-p 0.95。预算消融比较 \(2N\) 次解答生成加 majority voting，与 \(N\) 次解答生成加 \(N\) 次 GenSelect generation；这只能近似对齐 generation-call 数量，不能证明 token 或 latency 相等，而且选择阶段必须等候候选生成完成。论文没有报告目标候选池的 decontamination、精确 prompt 版本哈希、随机 seed、judge output 或已发布的执行 manifest。

相关 OpenMathReasoning 的构建是另一条 pipeline：先对带答案标签的解答池生成摘要；每道题构造八个不同的候选组，每组包含 2–16 条摘要，且至少有一个正确和一个错误候选；由 QwQ-32B 做选择；删除选择了错误候选的样本；再由 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 清洗接受的比较轨迹。约一百万次 generation 最终过滤成 565,620 条公开记录。公开的九字段 schema 在 problem 内保留完整候选摘要组和未选摘要，在 generated_solution 内保留 rationale 与可解析索引；它没有独立的 chosen-index 列，也没有逐候选 correctness-label vector。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On QwQ-32B's 64-candidate Comp-Math-24-25 pools, Table 3 reports 68.4% for Majority@64, 66.8% for Qwen2.5-Math-RM-72B, 69.1% for the pointwise QwQ GenRM, 72.1% for QwQ GenSelect@1, and 73.4% when GenSelect is repeated eight times and its selected answers are majority-voted; Pass@64 is 85.2%. These are selector accuracies over the same reported pool, not evidence that any released dataset is complete or high quality. The gap to Pass@64 also shows that selection remains materially imperfect even when a correct candidate is present.

Table 4 varies the tournament branching factor over \(N \in \{2,4,8,16\}\) while retaining 64 candidates. GenSelect@1 ranges from 72.1% to 72.6%, and GenSelect@8 ranges from 73.0% to 73.4%. The authors interpret this as stability across the tested brackets, which supports reducing sequential rounds when context permits. It does not establish order invariance: the final system still repeats random candidate permutations 32 times, and the paper does not publish per-permutation variance or bracket-level decision logs.

The equal-generation-call ablation in Table 2 is conditional on model and budget. For DeepSeek-R1-0528, \(2N\) generation plus majority voting versus \(N\) generation plus \(N\) GenSelect generation yields 82.8% versus 82.4% at \(N=4\), 84.4% versus 85.9% at \(N=8\), and 84.4% versus 87.1% at \(N=16\). For QwQ-32B, the corresponding values are 66.4% versus 69.5%, 66.8% versus 69.5%, and 68.0% versus 71.9%. The paper explicitly notes that the selector allocation has worse latency because verification starts after generation; no token-normalized or wall-clock comparison is reported.

In the final 32-repeat, \(N=8\) tournament with 64 candidates, Table 5 reports DeepSeek-R1-0528 pass@1 of 71.2%, maj@64 of 84.0%, and Self-GenSelect@32 of 87.1% over all 256 problems. QwQ-32B reports 60.0%, 68.4%, and 73.0%, respectively. Most of the stated gain is on the HMMT subset, whose correctness uses an LLM judge. All results are author-reported and were not independently reproduced for this Card.

在 QwQ-32B 的 64 候选 Comp-Math-24-25 候选池上，Table 3 报告 Majority@64 为 68.4%，Qwen2.5-Math-RM-72B 为 66.8%，逐点 QwQ GenRM 为 69.1%，QwQ GenSelect@1 为 72.1%；当 GenSelect 重复八次并对其所选答案做多数投票时为 73.4%，Pass@64 为 85.2%。这些是在同一报告候选池上的 selector accuracy，不能证明任何已发布数据集完整或高质量。与 Pass@64 的差距也说明，即使池中存在正确候选，选择器仍有明显错误。

Table 4 在保持 64 个候选的同时，把淘汰赛分支数设为 \(N \in \{2,4,8,16\}\)。GenSelect@1 的范围为 72.1%–72.6%，GenSelect@8 为 73.0%–73.4%。作者据此认为方法在测试的赛制间较稳定，这支持在 context 允许时减少串行轮次，但并不能证明对顺序不敏感：最终系统仍在随机候选排列下重复 32 次，而且论文未发布逐排列方差或 bracket-level decision log。

Table 2 的等 generation-call 消融依赖模型与预算。对 DeepSeek-R1-0528，\(2N\) 次生成加 majority voting 与 \(N\) 次生成加 \(N\) 次 GenSelect generation 在 \(N=4\) 时分别为 82.8% 与 82.4%，在 \(N=8\) 时为 84.4% 与 85.9%，在 \(N=16\) 时为 84.4% 与 87.1%。对 QwQ-32B，对应结果分别为 66.4% 与 69.5%、66.8% 与 69.5%、68.0% 与 71.9%。论文明确指出 selector 方案 latency 更差，因为 verification 只能在 generation 完成后开始；文中没有 token-normalized 或 wall-clock 对比。

在最终的 32 次重复、\(N=8\)、64 候选赛制中，Table 5 报告 DeepSeek-R1-0528 在全部 256 道题上的 pass@1 为 71.2%、maj@64 为 84.0%、Self-GenSelect@32 为 87.1%。QwQ-32B 对应为 60.0%、68.4% 和 73.0%。论文所述增益主要来自 HMMT 子集，而该子集的正确性由 LLM judge 判定。所有结果均为作者报告，本 Card 未进行独立复现。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Pointwise outcome reward models and GenRMs assign each candidate an independent score or correctness decision; pairwise schemes exploit comparison but either pay \(O(N^2)\) for exhaustive ranking or use a deep binary bracket. GenSelect's concrete change is the feedback interface: one prompted reasoning model jointly reads several indexed solution summaries, produces a comparative rationale, and names one index. An N-ary bracket then applies that interface beyond the context limit. The paper's direction signal is therefore comparative selector traces and tournament structure, not a new benchmark, generator, learned reward model, or training algorithm.

Several components are inherited. Candidate sampling and majority voting are standard test-time scaling mechanisms; the N-ary knockout design follows PairJudge-RM; solution summaries are an input compression choice; and QwQ-32B and DeepSeek-R1-0528 are used without selector-specific fine-tuning. The paper's novelty is narrower than "training a better verifier": it shows that existing reasoning models can be prompted to perform N-way selection and studies branching factor and generation-versus-selection allocation on competition math.

For reasoning-data research, the useful change is the record boundary. A GenSelect trajectory can retain all candidate summaries, their order and group assignment, the generated comparative analysis, parsed selected index, tournament edges, repetitions, permutations, generation and selector budgets, and separately computed correctness. That structure exposes non-selected candidates and selection decisions that majority-vote-only records discard. Before reuse, however, one must verify whether the stored candidates are full traces or summaries, whether failures are retained, how indices are parsed, and whether compute is normalized by calls, tokens, or latency.

The 565,620-row OpenMathReasoning genselect split is relevant implementation lineage, not evidence that the paper released its experimental corpus. Its packed fields make the candidate group and selector output inspectable, but the public schema does not provide standalone chosen-index or per-candidate correctness columns, and correctness-filtered construction drops failed selectors.

逐点 outcome reward model 与 GenRM 会为每个候选独立给出分数或正确性判断；两两比较方案能利用比较能力，但穷举排序需付出 \(O(N^2)\) 开销，二叉淘汰赛又具有较深的串行赛程。GenSelect 的具体改变在于 feedback interface：一个通过 prompt 调用的推理模型同时读取多个带索引的解答摘要，生成比较 rationale，并给出一个索引；N 叉赛制再把该接口扩展到 context 上限之外。因此，论文提供的方向信号是比较式 selector trace 与淘汰赛结构，而不是新 benchmark、新 generator、学习得到的 reward model 或 training algorithm。

多个组件来自既有工作。候选采样与 majority voting 是标准 test-time scaling 机制；N 叉淘汰设计沿用 PairJudge-RM；解答摘要是一种输入压缩选择；QwQ-32B 与 DeepSeek-R1-0528 没有接受 selector-specific fine-tuning。论文的 novelty 比“训练出更好的 verifier”更窄：它表明现有推理模型可以通过 prompt 执行 N 路选择，并在竞赛数学上研究分支数以及 generation 与 selection 的预算分配。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，有用的变化是记录边界。一条 GenSelect trajectory 可以保留所有候选摘要、顺序与分组、生成式比较分析、解析出的 selected index、淘汰赛边、重复次数、排列、generation 与 selector 预算，以及单独计算的正确性。这种结构暴露了只保存 majority-vote 最终结果时会丢失的未选候选与选择决策。但复用前仍需核查：保存的是完整轨迹还是摘要、失败样本是否保留、索引如何解析，以及算力是按调用次数、token 还是 latency 归一化。

OpenMathReasoning 的 565,620 条 genselect split 是相关实现 lineage，不是论文发布其实验语料的证据。其打包字段允许检查候选组和 selector output，但公开 schema 没有独立的 chosen-index 或逐候选 correctness 列，而且按正确性过滤的构建过程删除了失败 selector。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The selector sees summaries rather than the original long reasoning traces. A summary can omit a local algebraic error, an invalid recovery after backtracking, or uncertainty that would change a comparison. The paper's preliminary "no significant benefit" statement does not include a released ablation corpus or enough detail to audit what information the summarizer preserved. QwQ summaries are regenerated by Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, adding a second model's compression behavior to the lineage.

Self-GenSelect uses the same reasoning model as candidate generator and selector. Shared model priors, answer-format habits, or correlated mathematical errors can therefore survive both stages. The generated Judgment: IDX is also a brittle interface: malformed text, an out-of-range index, or a rationale inconsistent with its last line needs an explicit parsing and failure policy, which the paper does not report in detail.

Tournament output can depend on candidate order, bracket composition, and early elimination. Repeating random permutations and majority-voting 32 selected answers reduces observed variance but does not guarantee invariance, and multiplies selector compute. The reported budget comparison equates numbers of generation calls rather than measured tokens, accelerator time, energy, or end-to-end latency. Because selection is sequentially downstream of generation, the call-count framing can hide a substantial deployment cost.

The evaluation covers only 256 recent competition-math problems. HMMT results depend on an LLM judge, whose outputs and error analysis are not released; judge false positives and false negatives can therefore affect the main gains. The paper does not disclose decontamination against the 2024–2025 questions or possible generator pretraining overlap. Exact candidate pools, full traces, selector outputs, correctness manifests, prompt/version hashes, seeds, and permutation logs are unavailable, blocking end-to-end replication and training reuse of the target object.

The related OpenMathReasoning release improves artifact access but has different limits. Its rows contain summaries rather than original candidate traces; accepted rows were filtered to selectors that chose a correct candidate, so failed decision traces are absent; Judgment: IDX and candidate groups are packed into text rather than normalized fields; and public rows omit per-candidate labels. The CC BY 4.0 dataset label and Apache-2.0 code license are explicit, but row-level rights for AoPS source posts are not documented in the inspected release material.

selector 看到的是摘要，而不是原始长推理轨迹。摘要可能省略局部代数错误、回溯后的无效修正，或足以改变比较结论的不确定性。论文关于“没有显著收益”的预实验表述没有附带可发布的消融语料，也没有提供足够细节来审计 summarizer 保留了什么信息。QwQ 摘要由 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 重新生成，使 lineage 中又加入一个模型的压缩行为。

Self-GenSelect 使用同一个推理模型生成候选并充当 selector。因此，共享的模型先验、答案格式习惯或相关数学错误可能同时穿过两个阶段。生成式 Judgment: IDX 也是脆弱接口：格式错误、越界索引，或 rationale 与最后一行不一致时，都需要明确的解析与失败处理策略，而论文没有详细报告这些规则。

淘汰赛输出可能依赖候选顺序、分组和早期淘汰。对随机排列重复 32 次并对所选答案做 majority voting 可以降低观测方差，但不能保证不变性，而且会成倍增加 selector compute。论文的预算比较对齐的是 generation call 数量，而不是实际 token、加速器时间、能耗或端到端 latency。由于 selection 串行地位于 generation 之后，按调用次数核算可能掩盖显著部署成本。

实验只覆盖 256 道近期竞赛数学题。HMMT 结果依赖 LLM judge，而其输出和错误分析没有发布；judge false positive 与 false negative 因而可能影响主要增益。论文没有披露针对 2024–2025 题目的 decontamination，也没有说明 generator pretraining overlap。精确候选池、完整轨迹、selector output、correctness manifest、prompt/version hash、seed 与 permutation log 均不可用，因此目标对象无法端到端复现，也不能直接用于训练复用。

相关 OpenMathReasoning release 改善了 artifact 可得性，但存在不同限制。公开行包含摘要而非原始候选轨迹；构建过程只保留 selector 选中正确候选的样本，因此缺少失败决策轨迹；Judgment: IDX 与候选组以文本方式打包，而不是规范化字段；公开行也没有逐候选标签。数据集明确标为 CC BY 4.0，代码为 Apache-2.0，但所核查的 release material 没有说明 AoPS 源帖的逐行权利。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data track, GenSelect supplies a concrete schema for separating generation from selection. A reproducible record should include problem and source; generator and decoding settings; every candidate's stable ID, full trace, summary, extracted answer, and order; group and bracket membership; selector model, prompt version, generated comparison, parsed index, and parse status; repetition and permutation IDs; selected answer; answer checker or judge version and output; token, call, and latency budgets; and retention flags for selected, non-selected, and failed candidates. With these fields, researchers can audit whether gains come from a better candidate pool, better comparative reasoning, repeated voting, or additional compute.

The method can be used as an evaluation baseline for pointwise versus comparative verifiers, an ablation surface for branching factor and candidate order, and a test-time compute policy for studying how generation and selection budgets interact. The unreleased target traces are suitable only as a reading and audit reference: the paper supports reproducing the high-level evaluation design, but not direct training reuse or exact result replication.

The related OpenMathReasoning genselect split can support format inspection and, subject to its CC BY 4.0 terms and source-rights review, experiments on selector-trace training. Its 565,620 rows expose complete packed candidate-summary groups, non-selected summaries, selector reasoning, and a parseable judgment. Reusers should first normalize the packed index into a standalone field, reconstruct per-candidate labels where justified, document parse failures, and recognize that incorrect selector runs were filtered out. Any SFT use belongs to that release's lineage; it must not be reported as a training use demonstrated by the target GenSelect paper.

Useful comparisons within the Atlas include aimo2-openmathreasoning-2025 for the construction and release lineage, and learning-generative-selection-2026 for later work that trains a selector rather than relying only on prompt-time behavior.

对 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 轨道而言，GenSelect 提供了把 generation 与 selection 分开的具体 schema。一条可复现记录应包含：题目与来源；generator 与 decoding 设置；每个候选的稳定 ID、完整轨迹、摘要、抽取答案和顺序；分组与 bracket membership；selector model、prompt version、生成式比较、解析出的索引和 parse status；重复与 permutation ID；被选答案；answer checker 或 judge 的版本与输出；token、调用次数与 latency 预算；以及 selected、non-selected 与 failed candidate 的保留标记。有了这些字段，研究者才能审计增益来自更好的候选池、比较式推理、重复投票还是额外算力。

该方法可作为逐点 verifier 与比较式 verifier 的评测 baseline，可用于分支数和候选顺序的消融，也可作为研究 generation 与 selection 预算如何交互的 test-time compute policy。未发布的目标轨迹只能作为阅读与审计参考：论文足以支持重建高层评测设计，但不支持直接训练复用或精确结果复现。

相关 OpenMathReasoning genselect split 可用于格式检查，并可在遵守其 CC BY 4.0 条款且完成源数据权利审查后用于 selector-trace training 实验。其 565,620 条记录暴露完整的打包候选摘要组、未选摘要、selector reasoning 和可解析 judgment。复用者应先把打包索引规范化为独立字段，在有依据时重建逐候选标签，记录解析失败，并明确错误 selector 运行已在构建时被过滤。任何 SFT 用途都属于该 release 的 lineage，不能写成目标 GenSelect 论文已经验证的 training use。

Atlas 内适合对照阅读的条目包括：说明构建与发布 lineage 的 aimo2-openmathreasoning-2025，以及训练 selector 而不是仅依赖 prompt-time 行为的后续工作 learning-generative-selection-2026。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.2 and 4.3 with Tables 2–5: pool size 64, tournament branching factor \(N\), and the number of selector repetitions are different budgets.
  • Figure 2 defines the actual feedback interface: generated comparative reasoning followed by the zero-based text field Judgment: [IDX].
  • Treat 73.4% and 87.1% as author-reported selector results under specific QwQ and DeepSeek settings, not as proof that selector traces are high-quality training data.
  • Keep the target-paper object separate from OpenMathReasoning: the former's Comp-Math pools are unreleased; the latter has 565,620 packed, correctness-filtered training rows with no standalone chosen index or per-candidate labels.
  • Reproduction priorities are target candidate pools and seeds, full versus summarized traces, prompt and parser versions, HMMT judge outputs, per-permutation logs, and token/latency-normalized budgets.

• 应把 Section 3.2、4.3 与 Table 2–5 连读：64 个候选的 pool size、淘汰赛分支数 \(N\) 和 selector 重复次数是不同预算。
  • Figure 2 定义了实际 feedback interface：先生成比较式推理，再输出零基文本字段 Judgment: [IDX]。
  • 73.4% 与 87.1% 是特定 QwQ 和 DeepSeek 设置下由作者报告的 selector 结果，不能作为 selector trace 是高质量训练数据的证明。
  • 必须区分目标论文对象与 OpenMathReasoning：前者的 Comp-Math 候选池未发布；后者包含 565,620 条打包、按正确性过滤的训练记录，但没有独立 chosen index 或逐候选标签。
  • 复现时应优先核查目标候选池与 seed、完整轨迹和摘要轨迹的差异、prompt 与 parser 版本、HMMT judge output、逐排列日志，以及按 token/latency 归一化的预算。

value.html: The target paper evaluates on Comp-Math-24-25, a 256-problem collection from AIME 2024/2025 and HMMT 2024/2025 after excluding proof and estimated-partial-credit questions. The related official OpenMathReasoning genselect release instead derives from AoPS-centered training problems and must not be treated as the target paper's exact evaluation pool.

A math problem followed by zero-indexed candidate-solution summaries; the selector generates comparative reasoning and ends with Judgment: [IDX]. In the public OpenMathReasoning schema, the full candidate group is packed into problem and the selector rationale plus chosen index is packed into generated_solution.

QwQ-32B and DeepSeek-R1-0528 generate candidate solutions and act as self-selectors in the target paper; Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct regenerates QwQ solution summaries. In the related public split, QwQ-32B authors the selector reasoning and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct produces cleaned summaries of accepted comparisons.

Offline Best-of-N aggregation over independently sampled mathematical solutions. Direct N-way comparison is used when context permits; larger pools are reduced through N-ary knockout tournaments and repeated selection under random candidate permutations.

A reasoning model serves as a generative comparative verifier that returns a selected candidate index rather than a scalar score. AIME-style evaluation uses final-answer correctness, while HMMT uses the paper's cited LLM-judge setup. The related training release keeps only comparison traces that selected an answer-correct candidate.

A selector output is format-valid when its final judgment names an in-range candidate. It is evaluation-correct when the selected candidate reaches the benchmark answer or passes the HMMT judge. The related OpenMathReasoning release retains only selectors that chose a candidate labeled correct during construction.
QwQ-32B and DeepSeek-R1-0528 for the target paper's generation and self-selection experiments
unknown

QwQ-32B or DeepSeek-R1-0528 generates candidate solutions and acts as its own GenSelect verifier; Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct produces fresh QwQ solution summaries. The related OpenMathReasoning split uses QwQ-32B for GenSelect traces.

Target-paper candidate generation and verification use temperature 0.6; the final evaluation also uses top-p 0.95 and random candidate permutations. The related release samples 2-16 summaries per group, creates eight distinct groups per problem, and uses QwQ-32B to select among them; its selector-generation temperature is undisclosed.

The main target-paper evaluation uses 64 candidate solutions per problem. Table 3 repeats GenSelect once or eight times; the final Self-GenSelect setup repeats the tournament 32 times. The related hosted split contains 565,620 accepted GenSelect rows after filtering about 1M selection generations.
Target-paper generation and verification use 0.6; related OpenMathReasoning GenSelect data-generation temperature is unknown.

Comp-Math-24-25 excludes proof-based and estimated-partial-credit questions. The target paper summarizes candidates before comparison but reports no correctness-based filtering of the 64-solution evaluation pools. The related release constructs groups with at least one correct and one incorrect summary and filters roughly 1M QwQ selections to 565,620 rows by removing selectors that chose an incorrect candidate.

For 64 candidates, the paper's 16-way tournament uses four first-round comparisons and one final comparison, while the final N=8 setup uses two rounds and repeats selection 32 times. The budget ablation compares 2N solution generations against N solution generations plus N GenSelect generations and explicitly notes added selection latency; equal token use is not established.

The target paper uses prompt-only N-ary tournament selection and majority aggregation without selector training or parameter optimization. The related OpenMathReasoning artifact was used as SFT data in its prior release paper, which is recorded as lineage rather than broadened into this entry's training_use.

The target evaluation contains 256 competition-math questions from AIME 2024, AIME 2025, HMMT November 2024, HMMT February 2024, and HMMT February 2025. The related 565,620-row release is AoPS-centered OpenMathReasoning training data rather than those Comp-Math evaluation records.

The target paper reports an evaluation-only Comp-Math-24-25 collection and does not release its exact candidate pools. OpenMathReasoning exposes genselect as a 565,620-row mode split within the larger dataset, not as an independent train/validation/test partition.

Undisclosed for the target paper's candidate pools. The related OpenMathReasoning pipeline reports LLM-based benchmark decontamination of source problems, but candidate pairs, judge outputs, and final decision logs are not released.

items: Replacing full reasoning traces with summaries can omit errors, backtracking, or evidence relevant to selection.
Self-selection can preserve generator-specific biases and correlated errors because the same model family generates and judges candidates.
Tournament brackets and candidate order can affect the winner; repeated random permutations reduce but do not remove this sensitivity and multiply compute.
The equal-budget ablation counts generation calls but does not establish equal token usage or latency; the paper explicitly notes additional selection latency.
HMMT correctness depends on an LLM judge rather than a fully programmatic verifier.
No exact Comp-Math candidate pools, selector traces, correctness-label manifests, chosen-index records, or random seeds were verified as released.

The related OpenMathReasoning rows include complete indexed candidate-summary groups and non-selected summaries, but the public nine-field schema omits explicit per-candidate correctness labels and a standalone chosen-index field.
The related release contains candidate summaries rather than the original full reasoning traces, so it cannot support a full audit of errors discarded during summarization.
Decontamination and possible generator pretraining overlap with the 2024-2025 competition problems are undisclosed.

Competition problem -> 64 temperature-0.6 QwQ-32B or DeepSeek-R1-0528 solutions -> final-answer extraction and solution summaries -> direct or tournament GenSelect reasoning -> selected candidate index -> repeated random-permutation selections -> majority-selected answer -> benchmark correctness or HMMT LLM judgment. Related release lineage is AoPS-centered problem -> answer-labeled solution pool -> 2-16-summary mixed-correctness group -> QwQ-32B comparison reasoning -> correct-selection filtering -> Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct cleanup -> packed nine-field OpenMathReasoning row.
